description: Bertholomus's ExLlamaV3 (EXL3) conversion of Reflection's Beam-1.0-501B-A23B (501B total, 23B active, 256 routed experts, 52 layers: 9 full-attention NoPE layers and 43 window-512 layers, 1,048,576-token context) for two DGX Spark (GB10) nodes: routed experts 3 bits (all 256 per layer), attention and dense MLPs 6 bits, embedding, norms, router and lm_head BF16, about 90 GiB per node at tensor parallel 2. Quantized with Diffbot's Beam EXL3 recipe on ExLlamaV3 v1.6.5; the creator measured KL 0.0121 (lower bound) and 96.87% top-1 agreement against BF16 on TensorFold. Not a Reflection release.
